Of the Mortification of Sin in Believers
Owen examines the believer’s fight against sin through the Spirit.
Begin with the opening exposition of Romans 8:13.

The Doctrine of Justification by Faith
An extended defense of justification and the imputation of Christ’s righteousness.
Use the contents to locate faith and imputation, then follow Owen’s biblical arguments.
The Death of Death in the Death of Christ
A sustained argument about the purpose and accomplishment of Christ’s death.
Read Book I on the aim of the atonement before testing the objections.
